mainText: This is Dose of Good for Friday, November 6. Here are 5 good news stories. First: Brazil expands Pantanal National Park by more than 25%. Pantanal Matogrossense National Park, managed by ICMBio, grew by 185 square miles. The region is home to 463 bird species and the largest concentration of jaguars on Earth. Second: Rescued dog returns to the pet shop where he was adopted and throws a party. Chico, rescued from the streets of Guarujá, reunited with Juliana and Carolina at the pet shop that cared for him. His owner posted the video. Third: Man uses ChatGPT to find a lost earbud among thousands of pebbles. The AI asked for closer photos and spotted the earbud in the third one. According to the Reddit post, it took under five minutes. Fourth: Students fill a football field with 250,000 pounds of food. At Howell High School in New Jersey, a Dermer Dreams drive collected more than 250,000 pounds of food, donated to 30 food banks. Fifth: Code of a 400-year-old shipwreck padlock is finally cracked. A micro-CT scan at Cardiff University revealed the code "ANCE" on a padlock from the Ann Francis, wrecked off Wales in 1583. That was your dose for today. See you tomorrow!
